data.one_liner: Create mailto URIs with support for multiple to, cc, bcc, subject, and body fields with encoding.
data.what_it_does: The mailto package helps build mailto links by providing a Dart interface for setting to, cc, bcc, subject, and body fields, while correctly encoding values. It is typically combined with a package like url_launcher to open the email client.
use_when: You want to let users open their email client with pre-filled fields to contact support or send feedback
You need to correctly encode mailto URI parameters according to the RFC 6068 standard
avoid_when: You need a bullet-proof, consistent email-sending mechanism across all devices and web clients
You need to handle extremely long mailto links exceeding 1000 characters
strengths: Supports multiple to, cc, and bcc fields
Handles URL encoding of special characters automatically
weaknesses: Mailto link behavior is inconsistent across different email clients and web browsers
May fail if the resulting link is extremely long
